summary: A UI action bus handler (subscribeById, subscribeByType, useAiClientActionById, useAiClientActionByType) that returns false now means 'declined': reported as rejected-handler instead of ok. UiActionHandler may return boolean.
howTo: Return false only when the action did not happen; return nothing (undefined) or true when it did, and nothing for an action that is not yours. A filtering handler such as bus.subscribeByType('glirastes.action', (a) => a.actionId === 'x' && run()) returns false for every other action and now makes those report 'declined': write if (a.actionId === 'x') run(); instead. All matching handlers still run; the dispatch rejects after them (a throw still stops the rest and wins). An app that calls bus.dispatch(...) or dispatchToolResultUiActions itself without awaiting or catching it now gets an unhandled rejection (UiActionRejectedError, reason 'handler'): add a .catch. With two SDK copies on a page, an older copy that created the shared bus first keeps false = ok.
